rows.label: tlk70000004_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Zain keeps a cool face, but it looks
like he built the shelter to the very
limit of what can work indoors.

rows.label: tlk70000004_03_msg0002
rows.name:
It's blast-, quake- and fireproof,
and built to hold even if this inn
collapsed under its own weight.

rows.label: tlk70000004_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Next we need to worry about
food, medicine stockpiles, air
filtering and the like...

rows.label: tlk70000004_03_msg0004
rows.name:
No need to worry. As you can see,
Iira's technology already surpasses
even Superbia's.

rows.label: tlk70000004_03_msg0005
rows.name:
If we can't handle it ourselves,
we can ask the palace engineers.
They'll be able to help.
